> **Security Reminder**: If this issue involves a security vulnerability (IP/DNS leak, auth bypass, Vault escape, etc.), please do **NOT** open a public issue. Report it privately via the repository's **Security → Advisories** tab (see `SECURITY.md`).
>
> **Privacy Reminder**: Never paste real proxy links (`vless://`, `trojan://`, `ss://`), UUIDs, API keys, AI session tokens, or `vault.db` files here.
